title: []Main[ALL-E] Dimensions of components are incorrectly populated when creating Production Order through Order Planning
summary: Order Planning now calculates component dimensions using the same inheritance and priority rules as Production Order Refresh, ensuring consistent dimension assignment for production order components regardless of creation method.
key_points: Component dimensions in Order Planning now follow Production Order source code and dimension-priority rules
Parent requisition line dimensions are inherited as Production Order Line dimensions
Non-conflicting component defaults are preserved while conflicting defaults no longer override parent dimensions
Added regression tests for no priorities, item priority, and parent priority scenarios
quote: Apply the Production Order source code and dimension-priority rules when calculating Order Planning component dimensions.
